# Jules

> Jules is a personal shopper you text in iMessage. Send it a screenshot, a photo or a link to something you want to wear, and it tells you what the item is and where to get it in your size, including cheaper options and resale.

Jules is in early access. People sign up at https://textjules.com/signup and then text Jules from their phone.

## What Jules does

- Identifies clothing, shoes and accessories from a screenshot, photo or product link.
- Finds the item in your size at different stores, including cheaper listings and resale (pre-owned) marketplaces, and suggests similar alternatives when you ask.
- Shows prices, shipping and conditions as the store lists them; it does not make up prices, stock or store policies, and says when something is unknown.
- Watches prices and restocks for items you choose to save, and texts you when a price drops or your size comes back.
- Learns your sizes and the stores you like from your messages, and optionally from order receipts if you connect Gmail.
- Does not buy anything for you: you check out on the store's own site.
